description:
Update fork downstream/MAINTAINING.md and core release/evidence/maintenance decision documents to actual implemented producer/consumer responsibilities. Explicitly supersede the earlier source-review-at-core-adoption convention from sqlglot-fork-review-h1-governance. Fork owns upstream integration, source/runtime/build verification, verified delivery and upstream exceptions; core trusts that product, validates origin/identity/hash, tests unique core integration/packaging and manages its own adoption PR. Remove claims that pasted fork diffs are reviewed by the core oracle. Do not add Theseus awareness, a new fork review App/required model-review status, duplicate source review or new test matrices. Preserve wheel-only/private namespace, ordinary protection/review policy, rollback, public release controls, scoped actors and cutover/hold/expiry recovery. Runbooks must match deployed workflow locations, schedule, credential ownership and kill switches, not a central core controller that no longer exists.

Document native fork git diff and producer evidence as the replacement for mandatory core fork-diff tooling before activation removes it. Activation, not this docs-only item or the fork controller, owns the later core code/workflow/test removal PR and obsolete core fork-token deletion. State that current core freshness/advisory checks remain unchanged release policy, not adoption orchestration; do not imply permission to delete or relax them. Document schema-versioned delivery, immutable version/hash and canonical same-source recovery with a newly verified attempt.
